## Activity

This report summarises activity at East City Eye Clinic during April 2024. The clinic recorded 231 captures during the reporting month. This figure represents the total capture activity submitted for review and provides the basis for the image quality and grading results reported below. The activity total is presented without adjustment or exclusion.

## Image quality

Of the captures recorded, 10 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.3. These results identify the volume of images that could not proceed through grading and the corresponding rate for the month. Image quality is reported separately from the overall capture total to support monitoring of the screening process.

## Grading

Grading identified 48 referable results. The median lag from image capture to grading was 2 days. Together, these measures summarise the grading outcome and the time taken for images to reach a grading decision during April 2024. The results provide the monthly operational position for East City Eye Clinic and should be considered alongside the activity and image quality measures above.
